proof_0457.moves: Given gamma1 <= gamma2, an element with v x <= gamma1 also satisfies v x <= gamma2; the whole argument is transitivity of the order on the value group, so the subgroup inclusion follows pointwise.

proof_0458.moves: Pure restatement: the norm of the star/orthogonal projection applied to a vector is transported from the already-proved orthogonalProjectionOnto form; no new mathematics beyond matching the two spellings.

proof_0459.moves: A continuous linear map is in particular a linear map, so the variance of L(X) for X real Gaussian is computed by the linear-map version of the variance formula.

proof_0460.moves: From 0 < -a deduce a < 0 by taking the forward direction of the equivalence neg_pos_iff, which holds in any additive group with a strictly monotone left addition.

proof_0461.moves: Unfold uIcc a b as Icc (a inf b) (a sup b), then apply monotonicity of Icc in both endpoints using inf_le_left for the lower endpoint and le_sup_right for the upper one.

proof_0462.moves: Extract the disjointness half of the complementarity hypothesis, then use that a disjoint pair in a lattice with bottom has infimum bottom.

proof_0463.moves: Set inclusion is the lattice order on Set, so the superset form of maximality is literally the ge form; apply Maximal.eq_of_ge after that identification.

proof_0464.moves: A fraction ring is the localization at the non-zero-divisor submonoid, so the localization form of 'integral implies almost integral' applies directly, with the trivial submonoid comparison supplied by reflexivity.

proof_0465.moves: One is a unit, and any unit is relatively prime to everything on that side; combine the two.

proof_0466.moves: An isometric ring hom is uniformly continuous, hence continuous, so the completion's induced ring hom agrees with the original map on the image of the canonical inclusion, by the general Completion.mapRingHom_coe.

proof_0467.moves: The coercion of a real function into the complexes preserves norms, so it is Theta-equivalent to the original; a Theta-equivalence on the left may be substituted inside a little-o statement.

proof_0468.moves: Monotonicity of the quotient congruence in the normal subgroup: feed the subgroup inclusion into the backward direction of the characterization con N <= c iff N is contained in the relevant class.

proof_0469.moves: In an order with no maximal element the point b is not maximal, which discharges the side condition of the general Ioo (succ b) = Ioc b identity.

proof_0470.moves: Pure dualization: pass to the order dual, where the statement becomes the already-proved 'eventually <= const iff for all greater, eventually < const', and transport back.

proof_0471.moves: An additive equivalence is an additive group hom, so subtraction is preserved by the general map_sub lemma for hom classes.

proof_0472.moves: A direct sum is a dependent finitely-supported function, and the map of the identity family is the identity mapRange, so the statement is the DFinsupp identity lemma.

proof_0473.moves: The empty set is collinear, and any collinear set is coplanar; chain the two facts.

proof_0474.moves: Surjectivity is proved by exhibiting a witness: given a morphism in the full subcategory of fibrant objects, take its underlying morphism, and homMk of it is definitionally the same morphism, so reflexivity closes the goal. The real content is the witness plus a definitional unfolding, not a cited lemma.

proof_0475.moves: The curried and uncurried spellings of the function agree, so the multiplicative support statement is exactly the existing mulSupport_curry lemma.

proof_0476.moves: Immediate from the definition of the formal variable X as the series whose coefficients are the indicator of degree one; the equality holds by reflexivity after unfolding.

proof_0477.moves: The Hausdorff extended distance between two singletons is the distance between the points, which is exactly the isometry condition for the singleton embedding into the space of compacts.

proof_0478.moves: Assemble bijectivity on source/target from the two-sided inverse property together with the fact that the map sends source into target and its inverse sends target into source, via InvOn.bijOn.

proof_0479.moves: An auto-generated side obligation for transporting a colimit along an isomorphism of cocones: rewrite the composite with the iso's inverse using comp_inv_eq, then close with uniqueness of the morphism out of the colimit. Most of the term is rewriting scaffolding produced by the tactic block.

proof_0480.moves: Unwrap the Raw tree map to its internal implementation and turn the Raw well-formedness hypothesis into the implementation-level invariant, then invoke the internal lemma bounding a member key by the maximum key.
